citation.note: For the date of the change only: South Sudan's independence on 9 July 2011.

notes: BorderDrift dates this change to 9 July 2011, South Sudan's independence, following Guidance Bulletin No. 30; Cliopatria gives only whole years. The bulletin describes Abyei as disputed; Abyei is drawn here as Cliopatria draws it.
